-- ── Strings (GlobalStrings.lua, verbatim) ─────────────────────────────────────────────── local CONFIRM_TALENT_WIPE = "Do you want to unlearn all of your talents? The cost will increase each time you do it." -- l.853 local ACCEPT = "Accept" -- l.10 local CANCEL = "Cancel" -- l.464
-- The dialog's only teardown, and like the innkeeper's it is a poll rather than an event: -- walk away from the trainer and the question leaves the screen by itself, with no packet -- either way. `CheckTalentMasterDist()` is the engine binding behind it -- (`benilla-ui/src/script/talent.rs`), false as soon as the app's NPC-session guard has -- closed the question. Named rather than inlined, because "the question expires when you -- walk away" is the interesting half of this file. local function hideOnceOutOfRange(_, dialog) if not CheckTalentMasterDist() then dialog:Hide() end end
-- ── The confirm — answering to StaticPopup.lua l.1289-1304 ───────────────────────────── StaticPopupDialogs["CONFIRM_TALENT_WIPE"] = { text = CONFIRM_TALENT_WIPE, button1 = ACCEPT, button2 = CANCEL, OnAccept = function() ConfirmTalentWipe() end, OnUpdate = hideOnceOutOfRange, hasMoneyFrame = 1, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, }
-- ── The UIParent event arm (UIParent.lua l.533-538) ──────────────────────────────────── -- arg1 is the cost in COPPER, and it goes to the money frame rather than into the text: -- the sentence above is fixed. The nil guard is the reference's own — Show returns nothing -- when the dialog is refused (dead without whileDead, or no free instance), and there is -- then no money frame to fill. function BenillaTalentWipeConfirmDriver_OnEvent() if event == "CONFIRM_TALENT_WIPE" then local dialog = StaticPopup_Show("CONFIRM_TALENT_WIPE") if dialog then MoneyFrame_Update(dialog:GetName() .. "MoneyFrame", arg1) end end end
